blurb: The Smithsonian's museum of flight, free, on the National Mall.

facts.t: The 1903 Wright Flyer, which flew 12 seconds at Kitty Hawk, hangs here. Because of a long quarrel with the Smithsonian it spent 20 years in London's Science Museum, and came to Washington only in 1948.
The Apollo 11 command module Columbia, which carried Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins to the Moon and back in July 1969, is on show, scorched by re-entry.
